title: Mixing: Power Cut by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

‘Power Cut’, the closing song on Wings’ second album Red Rose Speedway, was mixed in stereo on 15 January 1973.

The mix took seven attempts before Paul McCartney was satisfied. The album medley was assembled the following day.
